name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=shop within ui_menu system, descriptor=menu_input_loop). Accurately reflects the function's role as the per-frame input/navigation loop driving the buy/sell/give item shop grid. No Ghidra address residue in the name. All three callers (fd2_run_buy_item_menu / fd2_run_sell_item_menu / fd2_run_give_item_menu) are shop-style 2-column item grids, so 'shop' domain is correct.
purpose: Per-frame cursor-navigation + row-paged scroll input loop for the shop buy/sell/give-item screens, laid out as a 2-column grid showing 6 items at a time; returns when the user commits or cancels.
logic_summary: Infinite loop: read one scancode via fd2_wait_input_with_chapter_dialog_blink(1) (mode 1 = 2-panel layout). Dispatch on scancode: Right(0x4D) cursor+=1 if not last; Left(0x4B) cursor-=1 if not first; Up(0x48) cursor-=2 if cursor>1 (row up); Down(0x50) cursor+=2 if cursor<item_count-2 (row down). On any move, play SFX 0 (cursor chime via fd2_play_sfx_with_handle on the FDOTHER SFX bank), page the 6-item viewport by 2 with a scroll animation (fd2_animate_scroll_up/down_in_shop_dialog) when the cursor leaves the [scroll_offset .. scroll_offset+5] window, then re-render via fd2_render_shop_item_grid(item_count, item_id_array, cursor, 0xA0000, sell_mode_flag&0xFF). Enter(0x1C)/Space(0x39) set result=1 (commit); Esc(0x01) sets result=-1 (cancel). Loop exits (returns result) as soon as result!=0. __CHK stack-check prologue present.
signature: int __cdecl fd2_shop_menu_input_loop(uint32 item_count, uint8 *item_id_array, uint32 sell_mode_flag)

params.name: param_1
params.semantics: Number of items in the grid. Used for end-of-list bound checks (param_1-1 = last index for Right, param_1-2 for Down) and passed through to fd2_render_shop_item_grid. Caller values: shop_item_count / inv_count.
params.reason: Generic param_1 name carries no meaning and is an address-agnostic placeholder; the value is unambiguously the item count driving all bound checks and the render call.

params.name: param_2
params.semantics: Pointer to the array of item IDs to display; passed straight through to fd2_render_shop_item_grid as the item-id source. Caller values: shop_item_id_array / char_inventory / inv_list.
params.reason: Generic param_2 placeholder; the value is the item-id array forwarded to the grid renderer.

params.name: param_3
params.semantics: Sell/give mode flag. Forwarded (masked &0xFF) to fd2_render_shop_item_grid to select buy vs sell/give rendering. Callers pass 0 for the buy menu, 1 for sell and give menus.
params.reason: Generic param_3 placeholder; the value is the buy(0)/sell-or-give(1) rendering mode flag passed to the grid renderer.

returns.semantics: 1 = user committed the highlighted item (Enter 0x1C / Space 0x39); -1 = user cancelled (Esc 0x01). Never returns 0 (the loop only exits when result becomes non-zero). The committed/cancelled selection index is read by callers from the global data_fd2_ui_menu_cursor_idx.

notes: Source comment block (shop.c lines 56-83) is already precise, ASCII, and consistent with the decompilation (covers purpose, per-key dispatch, scroll paging, globals, and the EAX-narrowing note), so comment_verdict=keep and shop.c was left untouched. Ghidra plate is detailed and consistent with the refined understanding (no contradiction), so ghidra_plate_action=none; no save_program needed. Globals data_fd2_ui_menu_cursor_idx (0x53C57) and data_fd2_ui_menu_scroll_offset (0x5412F) are both read and written; data_fd2_audio_fdother_sfx_bank_buf_ptr (0x53EEC) is read-only here.
